animation_contract.runs: Frames 1..17 at 24 FPS, duration 0.666667 s, looped
animation_contract.blend: Outer Simple1D Idle/Run controlled by Speed; inner SimpleDirectional2D cardinal Run motions controlled by normalized local MoveX/MoveY; corresponding trees in Base, Arms.Relaxed and Arms.Combat. Arms gestures remain independent and return to the Base phase.

migration.behavior: First setup copies the previous controller and replaces only generated run leaves, retaining states, transitions and settings. Unrecognized custom legacy trees are rejected rather than overwritten. Repeated setup preserves edited directional trees. Legacy weapon overrides and profiles migrate as copies with overrides retained; unrelated bases are rejected with a clear message.

runtime: MoveX/MoveY derive from actual CharacterController displacement after collision and after the turn-pivot correction, relative to visual model forward including ModelForwardYaw. Analog Speed remains separate. Angular smoothing keeps a unit direction on reversal; stationary fade keeps the last direction; new movement sets direction immediately. Existing cancellation and aim-hold behavior is preserved.

notes: C# syntax parsing is not Unity type checking. Migration and blend tree appearance require Unity Editor verification.
Directional clip geometry and foot contact validation are documented in the Blender report.
